## 9. The packets and synched data of all the above, field by field

### 9.1 The living body: packets and synched data, field by field

Protocol ids from `generated/reports/packets.json` (play, clientbound). Codecs from the
packet classes in `reference/n7-javap/` (or `n5-javap` where named). Entity ids are the
edge's wire ids, translated (ADR-0028 section 1), in every field that holds one.

| Packet | id | Fields, in order | Sent | From |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `add_entity` | 1 | varint id; UUID; varint entity type (registry id); double x, y, z (the tracker's position base); `LpVec3` motion (last sent); byte pitch, byte yaw (packed, last sent); byte head yaw (packed `lastSentYHeadRot`); varint data (0 for mobs) | pairing | n5-javap ClientboundAddEntityPacket.txt 36–66, write 199– |
| `set_entity_data` | 101 | varint id; per value: byte index, varint serializer id, the value; byte 255 | pairing (non-default values) and whenever dirty, inside the gate, to trackers and self | ServerEntity.txt 1058–1116 |
| `update_attributes` | 134 | varint id; varint count (at most 128); per attribute: varint attribute registry id (`Attribute.STREAM_CODEC`, `holderRegistry`), double base value, varint modifier count, per modifier: `Identifier` id (string), double amount, operation (`ByteBufCodecs.idMapper`, AttributeModifier$Operation.txt 115: a varint, 0 `add_value`, 1 `add_multiplied_base`, 2 `add_multiplied_total`) | pairing (every syncable instance that exists, if any) and after dirty data (the changed syncable ones), to trackers and self | ClientboundUpdateAttributesPacket.txt 9–101, `$AttributeSnapshot` 65–89 |
| `set_equipment` | 104 | varint id; per slot: byte `ordinal | 0x80` when another follows (`ordinal` of `EquipmentSlot`: 0 main hand, 1 off hand, 2 feet, 3 legs, 4 chest, 5 head, 6 body, 7 saddle), then `ItemStack.OPTIONAL_STREAM_CODEC` | pairing (non-empty slots in `VALUES` order: main hand, off hand, feet, legs, chest, head, body, saddle) and on a change (`detectEquipmentUpdates`) | ClientboundSetEquipmentPacket.txt 64–115 |
| `rotate_head` | 85 | varint id; byte head yaw (packed) | inside the gate when it changed by ≥ 1 | ServerEntity.txt offsets 888–939 |
| `set_entity_motion` | 103 | varint id; `LpVec3` motion | motion rule in the gate (trackers), and `syncVelocity` after it (trackers and self) | ClientboundSetEntityMotionPacket.txt 75–92 |
| `move_entity_pos` / `_pos_rot` / `_rot`, `entity_position_sync` | 54 / 55 / 57, 35 | as the N4 brief section 9 | as there | ServerEntity.txt 560–653 |
| `entity_event` | 34 | **int** (4 bytes) id; byte event | at once, to trackers and self | ClientboundEntityEventPacket.txt 36–46; ServerLevel.txt 2534–2546 |
| `damage_event` | 25 | varint id; varint damage type id (`DamageType.STREAM_CODEC`; the id in the `damage_type` registry the server sent, Clustine's sorted order); varint cause id + 1 (0: none); varint direct id + 1 (0: none); optional (boolean, then three doubles) source position | a counted, unblocked hit, to trackers and self | ClientboundDamageEventPacket.txt 15–56, 84–129, 233–252; ServerLevel.txt 2547–2559 |
| `hurt_animation` | 43 | varint id; float yaw (`getHurtDir()`) | only to a player about itself (`ServerPlayer.indicateDamage`, n5-javap ServerPlayer.txt 5257–5292, which sets `hurtDir = (float)(Mth.atan2(dz, dx) * 57.2957763671875 − yRot)`) | ClientboundHurtAnimationPacket.txt 9–56 |
| `animate` | 2 | varint id; unsigned byte action: 0 wake up, 1 critical hit, 2 magic critical hit | crits (a player's attack, 1.9), waking | ClientboundAnimatePacket.txt 5–56 |
| `swing_animation` | 123 | **not read** (`ClientboundSwingAnimationPacket` not dumped): entity, hand, `SwingAnimation` | `LivingEntity.swing`, to trackers (and self when asked) | LivingEntity.txt 5139–5170 |
| `take_item_entity` | 127 | varint item id; varint collector id; varint amount | `LivingEntity.take` | ClientboundTakeItemEntityPacket.txt 44–60 |
| `set_entity_link` | 102 | **int** leashed id; **int** holder id (0 for none) | pairing of a leashed mob; a lead tied or dropped | ClientboundSetEntityLinkPacket.txt 41–56 |
| `update_mob_effect` | 135 | varint id; varint effect (`MobEffect.STREAM_CODEC`); varint amplifier; varint duration; byte flags (1 ambient, 2 visible, 4 show icon, 8 blend) | to a player about itself, or about its mount | ClientboundUpdateMobEffectPacket.txt 5–135 |
| `remove_mob_effect` | 79 | varint id; varint effect | as above | ClientboundRemoveMobEffectPacket.txt 75–88 |
| `remove_entities` | 78 | as the N4 brief | when a viewer stops seeing it, and at removal | ServerEntity.txt 820–840 |

**Synched data of a mob**, by class (the serializer wire ids from the N5 brief 8.2):

| Index | Owner | Serializer | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0–7 | `Entity` | as N5 brief 8.2 | | shared flags, air 300, custom name, name visible, silent, no gravity, pose, frozen ticks |
| 8 | `LivingEntity` | `BYTE` 0 | 0 | 1 using an item, 2 in the off hand, 4 spin attack |
| 9 | `LivingEntity` | `FLOAT` 3 | 1.0 | health (always sent: set to the max at birth) |
| 10 | `LivingEntity` | `PARTICLES` 17 | [] | effect particles |
| 11 | `LivingEntity` | `BOOLEAN` 8 | false | effects ambient |
| 12 | `LivingEntity` | `INT` 1 | 0 | arrows stuck |
| 13 | `LivingEntity` | `INT` 1 | 0 | bee stingers stuck |
| 14 | `LivingEntity` | `OPTIONAL_BLOCK_POS` 11 | empty | sleeping position |
| 15 | `Mob` | `BYTE` 0 | 0 | 1 no AI, 2 left handed, 4 aggressive |
| 16 | `AgeableMob` | `BOOLEAN` 8 | false | baby |
| 17 | `AgeableMob` | `BOOLEAN` 8 | false | age locked |
| 18–19 | `TamableAnimal` | `BYTE`, `OPTIONAL_LIVING_ENTITY_REFERENCE` 13 | 0, empty | sitting/tame flags, owner (section 4) |

A type's own data starts at 16 for a mob that is not an `AgeableMob` (the golems and
the allay, `PathfinderMob`s; fish and tadpoles, `WaterAnimal`s) and at 18 for an
ageable one (animals, villagers and wandering traders, `AbstractVillager`; squids,
glow squids and dolphins, `AgeableWaterCreature`); each animal's section lists its
own.

**What a region must report for a mob, beyond N5's**: head yaw each tick it changes
(the edge packs and compares at its gate); data changes by index (health, the mob
flags, baby, the type's own); attribute changes (which syncable instance, its base and
modifiers); equipment changes; `needsSync` (any push: `Entity.push(DDD)`) and
`syncVelocity` (a hurt with knockback: `markHurt`); and events, as they happen: entity
events by byte, damage events (type, cause key, direct key, position), swings, takes.

**What the body's own rules send** (1.3–1.8; the codecs in the tables above):

- **Sounds** (`sound`, play 119, through `Level.playSound(null, …)` and the level's
  `soundSeedGenerator`): a mob's ambient sound (1.3: the type's, at the mob, its sound
  source, volume `getSoundVolume()` 1.0, pitch `getVoicePitch()`); its hurt sound
  (`getHurtSound(source)`, `generic.hurt` in `LivingEntity`, each type its own) and its
  death sound (`generic.death`) with the same volume and pitch rule, from `hurtServer`;
  the thorns hit (`thorns.hit`, `HOSTILE` for a mob); the fall sounds (`getFallSounds()`'s
  small below 5 damage, big above 4, volume 1, pitch 1) and the block's fall sound
  (volume × 0.5, pitch × 0.75); lava's `generic.burn` (volume 0.4, pitch `2 + 0.4·r`);
  equipping (`onEquipItem`, n5-brief 5.3, a seeded sound with the entity's `nextLong`).
  A silent entity (`Silent`) plays none of them but makes the pitch draws.
- **Entity events** (`entity_event`, 4-byte id): 3 at death, 60 at removal after 20
  ticks, 67 at each drowning hit, 35 a totem, 46 a random teleport, 47–52, 65, 68 an
  item breaking, 55 a swap of hands, 20 a spawner's spawn (`Mob.spawnAnim`), and each
  type's own (the table in 1.16).
- **The damage event** (`damage_event`) for every hurt that counts and is not blocked
  (1.4 step 13), to the trackers and the entity: the entity, the damage type, the cause
  and direct entities (+1, 0 for none) and the explicit source position, if any
  (`sourcePositionRaw`: of the dumped sources only `badRespawnPointExplosion` sets one,
  DamageSources.txt 566–577; a mob's attacker is told by its ids, and the client takes
  the direct entity's position for the tilt, **Client**).
- **Motion**: `knockback` and `jumpFromGround` set `needsSync` (the next update tick
  sends move and motion in the gate); `markHurt` sets `syncVelocity` (a
  `set_entity_motion` to trackers and the entity after the gate). A hurt of a mob in a
  tick thus sends its motion at the end of the next `sendChanges`.
- **Data**: health (9) after every hurt and heal; the pose (6) `DYING` at death; air (1)
  under water; frozen ticks (7) in powder snow; the mob flags (15) when `NoAI`, left
  handed or aggressive change; baby and age lock (16, 17); the effects' particles (10,
  11) when effects change; arrows (12) and stingers (13).
- **Attributes** (`update_attributes`): the instances made or changed since the last
  send, syncable ones only (1.2): `movement_speed` after the first tick, the powder snow
  slow-down's modifier (`minecraft:powder_snow`, `add_value`) as it changes, `scale`,
  `max_health` and the like when an effect or a command changes them.
- **Equipment** (`set_equipment`) from `detectEquipmentUpdates`; **takes**
  (`take_item_entity`) when a mob picks up an item (`Mob.pickUpItem`, the count taken) or
  a player an orb (`playerTouch`, count 1).
- **The orb**: `add_entity` of type `experience_orb` (data 0) and its data 8 (`DATA_VALUE`,
  `INT`, the value), then its moves (interval 20, deltas tracked).

**A player's hit, use and spawn egg** (1.9–1.11).

Ids from `generated/reports/packets.json` (play state).

**Serverbound**

| Packet | Id | Fields | Handled |
|---|---|---|---|
| `attack` (`ServerboundAttackPacket`) | 1 | the entity id (`VAR_INT`) | `handleAttack` → `Player.attack` (1.9.1, 1.9.2) |
| `interact` (`ServerboundInteractPacket`) | 26 | n5-brief 2.11: entity id, hand, location, secondary action | `handleInteract` → `Player.interactOn` (1.10.1) |
| `punch` (`ServerboundPunchPacket`) | 46 | none: `StreamCodec.unit` (ServerboundPunchPacket.txt static block) | `handlePunch`: main-hand swing for others, `resetAttackStrengthTicker` (1.9.1) |
| `use_item_on`, `use_item` | n5-brief 2.9 | | a spawn egg on a block (1.11.1), on water (1.11.3) |

The client sends `attack` then `punch` for a hit on an entity, and `interact` (main
hand, then the off hand if that passed) then `use_item` for a use (**Client**).

**Clientbound, in the order one hit on a mob produces them** (a bare hand at full
strength, not sprinting, the mob not invulnerable):

1. From `hurtServer` (1.4): the damage event, the hurt sound,
   `markHurt` / `knockback` (their packets come later, from `ServerEntity`).
2. `sound` (119) `player.attack.strong` (or `weak`; `crit`; `sweep`; `knockback` before
   the hurt for a strong sprint hit; `nodamage` when the hurt did not take) at the
   attacker's position, category the player's, volume 1, pitch 1, a seed from
   `soundSeedGenerator`, to every player in range including the attacker
   (`level.playSound(null, …)`).
3. A crit: `animate` (2) with the **target's** id and action `CRITICAL_HIT` 1; with an
   enchantment's extra damage also action `MAGIC_CRITICAL_HIT` 2. To the attacker and
   the players tracking the attacker. Codec: `VAR_INT` id, unsigned byte action
   (ClientboundAnimatePacket.txt). Actions: `WAKE_UP` 0, `CRITICAL_HIT` 1,
   `MAGIC_CRITICAL_HIT` 2; nothing else (1.0 finding 25: the repo's 0 and 3 are wrong).
4. A sweep: `level_particles` (48) `sweep_attack`, count 0, at `(x − sin·1, y + h/2, z +
   cos·1)` with the direction as its offset; each swept entity's own hurt packets.
5. More than 2 health taken: `level_particles` `damage_indicator`, count `(int)(dealt ×
   0.5)`, offset (0.1, 0, 0.1), speed 0.2, at the target's middle.
6. `swing_animation` (123) for the punch: the attacker's main hand, the item's attack
   animation, to the trackers only (`toSelf` false).
7. On the tick after (from `ServerEntity.sendChanges`): the target's move and motion
   (`needsSync`), then `set_entity_motion` (103) to the trackers and the entity
   (`syncVelocity`). A player target (PvP) is sent its motion at once by
   `causeExtraKnockback`.

**A use**: `swing_animation` per n5-brief 2.7 (a name tag or a golden dandelion:
`SUCCESS`, trackers only; a spawn egg on a mob or a lead: `SUCCESS_SERVER`, trackers and
the player); `set_entity_link` (102) for a lead (n5-brief 7.5); the name's
`set_entity_data` (data 2) on the mob's next data sync; the golden dandelion's `sound`
(`golden_dandelion.use`/`unuse`, category `PLAYERS`, at the mob's block) and its
`level_particles` (`pause_mob_growth` or `reset_mob_growth`, one each even tick for 40
ticks) and the age data (16 baby, 17 age locked) on change; shearing equipment: the
item's shearing sound, the item entity's spawn, `set_equipment` (1.8).

**A spawn egg**: the new mob's pairing packets as soon as it is added (`add_entity`,
`set_entity_data`, `set_equipment` if any; no `update_attributes`, which follows at its
first update tick with `movement_speed`: 1.2, 1.16), then its ambient sound (`sound` at the mob, the mob's category, volume
`getSoundVolume()`, pitch `getVoicePitch()`). On a spawner: the block entity's update
(**Inferred**: `block_entity_data`).

**Not sent**: no `entity_event` 20 (spawn poof) for eggs; no reply to a refused hit or
use.

### 9.2 Goals, controls and sensing

What the AI of section 2 changes that clients are sent. The packets themselves are
`ServerEntity`'s (N4 brief section 9, N5 brief 1.11); here, which field changes and when.

**Synched data.**

| Id | Accessor | Serializer | Default | Written by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 15 | `Mob.DATA_MOB_FLAGS_ID` | `BYTE` (0) | 0 | mask 1 `NoAI` (`setNoAi`, Mob.txt 3119–3144); mask 2 left-handed (`setLeftHanded`, 3146–3171); mask 4 aggressive (`setAggressive`, 3173–3198: `MeleeAttackGoal.start` true, `stop` false) |

Mob's flags follow `LivingEntity`'s 8 to 14 (N5 brief 5.6); a type's own data starts at
16. The aggressive mask is what a client shows as raised arms (zombies, piglins; N9) and
reads for some animals' poses; for N7's animals it changes with every melee attack's
start and end. `FlyingMoveControl` sets and clears `Entity`'s no-gravity flag (data 5,
`BOOLEAN`) as the operation changes (2.3), which is sent. Data written by goals but
belonging to a type (each type's section): `Wolf.setIsInterested` (`BegGoal`),
`TamableAnimal.setInSittingPose` (`SitWhenOrderedToGoal`, the cat's block goals), the
cat's lying (`CatLieOnBlockGoal`), the horse's standing and temper (`RandomStandGoal`,
`RunAroundLikeCrazyGoal`), the iron golem's offered flower (`OfferFlowerGoal`), the
copper golem's antenna slot (equipment: `SetEquipment`), a parrot on a player's
shoulder (the player's own data).

**Rotations and moves.** The look and body controls change `yHeadRot` every tick they
turn it, the move control `yRot`, the look control `xRot` (reset to 0 at the start of
each tick and turned again only while looking, 2.3). `ServerEntity` sends `yRot`/`xRot`
packed by `Mth.packDegrees` in its move packets at the type's update interval, and
`ClientboundRotateHeadPacket` (`rotate_head`: entity id as a varint, the packed head yaw
as a byte) whenever the packed `yHeadRot` differs from the last sent by at least 1 (N4
brief section 9, "head"). `yBodyRot` is never sent: the client computes its own body
yaw (**Client**). `clustine`'s edge sends no head rotation for any entity yet
(`services/edge/src/tracking.rs`, `send_changes`).

**Motion.** Set directly by `LeapAtTargetGoal.start` (motion `(v.x, yd, v.z)`),
`DolphinJumpGoal.start` (+`(0.6·dx, 0.7, 0.6·dz)`), `jumpFromGround` (which sets
`needsSync`), `jumpInLiquid`, `SmoothSwimmingMoveControl` (+0.005 y in water), and the
second moves of `BreathAirGoal` and `FollowPlayerRiddenEntityGoal`; `ServerEntity` sends
`SetEntityMotion` for a mob when its motion changes by more than its threshold at an
update (N4 brief section 9).

**Entity events** (`ClientboundEntityEventPacket`: id as an int, then the event as a
byte; N4 brief):

| Event | From | Meaning (**Client**) |
|---|---|---|
| 10 | `EatBlockGoal.start` (EatBlockGoal.txt 76–94) | the sheep lowers its head to eat for 40 ticks |
| 6 | `RunAroundLikeCrazyGoal.tick` (RunAroundLikeCrazyGoal.txt 107–175) | a horse's taming failed: smoke particles |
| 20 | `Mob.spawnAnim()` (Mob.txt 552–566), not a goal | the poof of a spawned mob |

**Other packets.**

- The melee swing: `MeleeAttackGoal.checkAndPerformAttack` → `Mob.swingForAttack(MAIN_HAND)`
  → `swing(hand, animation, false)` (Mob.txt 3570–3593), which sends
  `ClientboundAnimatePacket` (action 0, the main hand) to the mob's trackers (the
  living body's section has `swing`).
- Sounds: `Mob.playAmbientSound` (`makeSound(getAmbientSound())`: volume
  `getSoundVolume()` 1.0, pitch `getVoicePitch()`, LivingEntity.txt 3570–3581,
  5930–5963); the dolphin's jump (`DOLPHIN_JUMP`, 1, 1); a horse's stand sound; the
  wandering trader's finishing sound (`UseItemGoal.stop`). Each is a `SoundPacket` at the
  entity (N6 brief has its fields and its seed, which is the level's).
- Block changes: `EatBlockGoal`'s `destroyBlock(pos, false)` (the block update and level
  event 2001 of a break, without drops; N6 brief) or `levelEvent(2001, below, id of the
  grass block)` and `setBlock(below, dirt, 2)`.
- Teleports: `TamableAnimal.maybeTeleportTo` → `snapTo` (a jump of the position: the
  next update is a full `entity_position_sync`, N4 brief).

**Saved by the game** (for the record of N7's mobs): of the AI only `Mob`'s `NoAI`
(written only when true), `LeftHanded`, `home_pos` and `home_radius`, `CanPickUpLoot`,
`PersistenceRequired` (Mob.txt 651–797). Goals, locks, controls, targets, the sensing
caches, `tickCount`, `noActionTime` and `ambientSoundTime` are not saved (finding 5 of
section 2).

### 9.3 Navigation and path finding

**Nothing of navigation goes to an ordinary client.** No synched data accessor is
defined by `PathNavigation`, any navigation, any evaluator, `Path` or `Node`, and no
packet carries a path, a target or a node, so the edge has nothing to translate or send
for this section. What a client sees of a path is the mob's movement, sent as the n4 and
n5 briefs describe (`ServerEntity`), and its head and body turns from the controls
(section 2).

The one wire use is debug: `Mob.registerDebugValues` (`Mob` 3541–, its lambda 3642–) registers, for
`DebugSubscriptions.ENTITY_PATHS`, a `DebugPathInfo(path.copy(), navigation.getMaxDistanceToWaypoint())`
built by `Mob.lambda$registerDebugValues$0` whenever the path has debug data; the path's
debug data (`Path$DebugData`: the open set's nodes, the closed set, the targets) is
captured only when `ServerDebugSubscribers.hasAnySubscriberFor(ENTITY_PATHS)` is true
(`PathNavigation.lambda$new$0`, 1300–1305; `PathFinder` 128–139, 336–346). `Node`,
`Target`, `Path` and `PathType` have stream codecs for it (`Node.DEBUG_STREAM_CODEC`:
x, y, z as `INT`, then walked distance, malus (`FLOAT`), closed (`BOOL`), type (by id),
f (`FLOAT`); `Path.DEBUG_STREAM_CODEC`: reached, next index, target, nodes, debug data).
A vanilla client subscribes to debug values only in a development build (**Inferred**,
client code): Clustine can leave all of it out. The capture changes no result (it only
adds sets the search never reads).

**Saved data**: none (3.0 finding 2; `Mob.addAdditionalSaveData`/`readAdditionalSaveData`
write `CanPickUpLoot`, `PersistenceRequired`, `drop`, `LeftHanded`, `NoAI`, `home`,
`DeathLootTable`, `DeathLootTableSeed`). The malus map, the navigation and the path are
rebuilt empty when a mob is loaded.

### 9.4 Farm animals, breeding and ageing: packets and synched data, field by field

**Synched data.** Indices 0–7 are `Entity`'s, 8–14 `LivingEntity`'s (n5-brief 5.6), 15
`Mob`'s `DATA_MOB_FLAGS_ID` (`BYTE`: 1 no AI, 2 left-handed, 4 aggressive; section 1).
Serializer wire ids from `EntityDataSerializers`' registration order (n5
EntityDataSerializers.txt, static block): `BYTE` 0, `INT` 1, `BOOLEAN` 8, `COW_VARIANT`
23, `COW_SOUND_VARIANT` 24, `PIG_VARIANT` 28, `PIG_SOUND_VARIANT` 29, `CHICKEN_VARIANT`
30, `CHICKEN_SOUND_VARIANT` 31. The four variant serializers write the holder as a
VarInt of its id in its registry (`ByteBufCodecs.holderRegistry`, CowVariant.txt 140,
CowSoundVariant.txt 125, the same in the pig's and chicken's), which for the client is
the index in the `RegistryData` the edge sent (`clustine-data` `registries.rs`:
`cow_variant`/`pig_variant`/`chicken_variant` cold 0, temperate 1, warm 2;
`cow_sound_variant` classic 0, moody 1; `pig_sound_variant` big 0, classic 1, mini 2;
`chicken_sound_variant` classic 0, picky 1).

| Index | Accessor | Of | Serializer | Default | Set when |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 16 | `DATA_BABY_ID` | `AgeableMob` | `BOOLEAN` | false | `setAge` crosses 0 (AgeableMob.txt 287–315) |
| 17 | `AGE_LOCKED` | `AgeableMob` | `BOOLEAN` | false | the golden dandelion; loading (`AgeLocked`) |
| 18 | `DATA_VARIANT_ID` | `Cow` | `COW_VARIANT` | temperate (1) | `finalizeSpawn`, breeding, loading, components |
| 19 | `DATA_SOUND_VARIANT_ID` | `Cow` | `COW_SOUND_VARIANT` | classic (0) | `finalizeSpawn`, loading, components |
| 18 | `DATA_TYPE` | `MushroomCow` | `INT` | 0 (red) | lightning, breeding, loading, components |
| 18 | `DATA_BOOST_TIME` | `Pig` | `INT` | 0 | `boost()`: 140–980 |
| 19 | `DATA_VARIANT_ID` | `Pig` | `PIG_VARIANT` | temperate (1) | as the cow's |
| 20 | `DATA_SOUND_VARIANT_ID` | `Pig` | `PIG_SOUND_VARIANT` | classic (1) | as the cow's |
| 18 | `DATA_WOOL_ID` | `Sheep` | `BYTE` | 0 (white, not sheared) | colour at spawn, breeding, dye; sheared; eating |
| 18 | `DATA_VARIANT_ID` | `Chicken` | `CHICKEN_VARIANT` | temperate (1) | as the cow's |
| 19 | `DATA_SOUND_VARIANT_ID` | `Chicken` | `CHICKEN_SOUND_VARIANT` | classic (0) | as the cow's |
| 18 | `DATA_TYPE_ID` | `Rabbit` | `INT` | 0 (brown) | `finalizeSpawn`, breeding, loading, components |

Pairing sends `SetEntityData` with the values that differ from these defaults (n5-brief
1.11.2): a temperate cow with the classic sound sends no index 18 or 19; a baby sends
16 = true. **Note for the edge**: the default holder of a variant is the registry's
entry, so the index the edge compares against is the one in its own sent registry, not
the game's; with the same sorted order they agree.

`UpdateAttributes` at pairing for every living entity with syncable attributes (n5-brief
1.11.2, item 4): for these animals at least `max_health` and `movement_speed` (both
syncable, Attributes.txt static block), with their base values (4.8.1, 4.9.1, 4.10.1,
4.11.1, 4.12.2) and the follow-range modifier is not syncable (**Inferred**: only
syncable attributes are sent). The pig's speed is what a riding client drives with.

**Entity events** (`ClientboundEntityEventPacket`: the entity's id as an `int`, the
event as a byte; `clustine-protocol` `play.rs` 1588–1615):

| Event | Sent by | When | Client (**Client**) |

| 1 | `Rabbit.jumpFromGround` (288–331), server only | each hop | `spawnSprintParticle`, jump animation (15 ticks) |

| `pause_mob_growth` / `reset_mob_growth` | `makeAgeLockedParticle` (488–549), every 2nd tick of 40 | `getRandomX(1)`, `getRandomY(0.2) + bbHeight + (0.2 if locked)`, `getRandomZ(1)` | 1, 0, 0, 0, 0 |

| `effect` (`SpellParticleOption` colour −1, power 1.0f) | mooshroom fed a flower | x, `getY(0.5)`, z | 4; the same |
| `explosion` | mooshroom sheared (the conversion's callback) | x, `getY(0.5)`, z | 1, 0, 0, 0, 0 |

use, with the player, Mob.txt 2727–2770), `shear` (sheep and mooshroom shearing; a
saddle shorn), `eat` (`Mob.ate`, a sheep eating), `entity_place` (an egg laid),
`block_change` (a rabbit nibbling a carrot), `flap` (a chicken in the air), and the
`block_destroy` of `destroyBlock` when a sheep eats a plant (N6, `Level.destroyBlock`).
**Level events**: 2001 (block broken, with the state id) for grass a sheep eats (the
grass block's default state at the block below) and a carrot a rabbit nibbles (the old
state).

**Serverbound**: `Interact` (use on an entity, with hand and sneaking), `UseItem` (the
carrot on a stick while riding), `MoveVehicle` (the ridden pig), `PlayerInput`
(sneaking off) — N5's handlers.

### 9.5 Tamed and ridden animals: packets and synched data

**Serializer ids** (`EntityDataSerializers`' static initialiser, n5 dump, by the order of
`registerSerializer`; the repo has the ones marked *): BYTE 0*, INT 1*, LONG 2, FLOAT 3*,
ITEM_STACK 7*, BOOLEAN 8*, OPTIONAL_LIVING_ENTITY_REFERENCE 13, OPTIONAL_UNSIGNED_INT 19,
CAT_VARIANT 21, CAT_SOUND_VARIANT 22, WOLF_VARIANT 25, WOLF_SOUND_VARIANT 26,
PAINTING_VARIANT 34*, DYE_COLOR 43*.

Codecs:
- LONG: `EntityDataSerializer.forValueType(ByteBufCodecs.VAR_LONG)` (EntityDataSerializers
  static, offsets 26–32). `VAR_LONG` is the anonymous `ByteBufCodecs$8` (ByteBufCodecs
  static, offsets 112–119), not dumped: **Inferred** a VarLong, as its name says.
- OPTIONAL_LIVING_ENTITY_REFERENCE: `EntityReference.streamCodec()` (the UUID's,
  `UUIDUtil.STREAM_CODEC` mapped, EntityReference.txt (n6) 316–327) passed through a
  `StreamCodec$CodecOperation` (offsets 193–209): **Inferred** `ByteBufCodecs::optional`
  (`optional` is `new ByteBufCodecs$25(codec)`, ByteBufCodecs.txt 177–183, not dumped),
  so a boolean and, if true, the UUID as two longs, most significant first.
- OPTIONAL_UNSIGNED_INT: `OPTIONAL_UNSIGNED_INT_CODEC` is the anonymous
  `EntityDataSerializers$3` (offsets 240–256), not dumped: **Inferred** a VarInt, 0 for
  empty, else value + 1.
- CAT_VARIANT, CAT_SOUND_VARIANT, WOLF_VARIANT, WOLF_SOUND_VARIANT:
  `ByteBufCodecs.holderRegistry(key)` (WolfVariant.txt 140, WolfSoundVariant.txt 93,
  CatVariant.txt 147, CatSoundVariant.txt 93) = `registry(key, <indy #18>)`
  (ByteBufCodecs.txt 376–381), whose codec is the anonymous `ByteBufCodecs$32` (360–367),
  not dumped: **Inferred** a VarInt of the entry's id in the registry the client was sent,
  with no "+ 1" (unlike `PAINTING_VARIANT`'s `holder`).

**Per type, index: serializer, default** (the indices after `AgeableMob`'s 16 baby and 17
age locked):

| type | 18 | 19 | 20 | 21 | 22 | 23 | 24 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| wolf | BYTE 0 (1 sit, 4 tame) | OPT_LIVING_REF empty | BOOLEAN interested false | INT collar 14 | LONG anger end −1 | WOLF_VARIANT pale | WOLF_SOUND_VARIANT classic |
| cat | BYTE 0 | OPT_LIVING_REF empty | CAT_VARIANT black | BOOLEAN lying | BOOLEAN relaxed | INT collar 14 | CAT_SOUND_VARIANT classic |
| parrot | BYTE 0 | OPT_LIVING_REF empty | INT variant 0 | | | | |
| ocelot | BOOLEAN trusting | | | | | | |
| horse | BYTE flags (2 tame, 8 bred, 16 eating, 32 standing, 64 mouth) | INT variant \| markings << 8 | | | | | |
| donkey, mule | BYTE flags | BOOLEAN chest | | | | | |
| llama, trader llama | BYTE flags | BOOLEAN chest | INT strength 0 | INT variant 0 | | | |
| skeleton, zombie horse | BYTE flags | | | | | | |

A llama's strength is 0 until `finalizeSpawn` or a load sets it (1 to 5).

**Player** (the owner, for shoulders): 15 main hand (HUMANOID_ARM, `Avatar`), 16 model
customisation (BYTE), 17 absorption (FLOAT), 18 score (INT), 19 left shoulder parrot and
20 right (OPTIONAL_UNSIGNED_INT, the parrot's variant id) (Player.txt and Avatar.txt
static initialisers). `ServerPlayer.setShoulderEntityLeft(tag)` (n6 5589–5597) sets
index 19 from the compound's variant; the right likewise.

**Clientbound packets** (ids from `reports/packets.json`):
- `entity_event` (34): 6 taming failed (smoke) and 7 tamed (hearts) for tamable animals and
  horses (also the horse's thrown rider, event 6); 8 wolf starts shaking, 56 wolf stops
  shaking; 40 ocelot refused (smoke), 41 ocelot trusts (hearts). The client draws the
  particles.
- `set_entity_data` (101): the table above, changes per tick as `ServerEntity` sends them
  (n4-brief section 9).
- `set_equipment` (104): saddle (slot 7), body (6) for horses, wolves, llamas (carpets).
- `set_passengers` (109), `move_vehicle` (58, corrections), `player_position` on mount and
  dismount: as for boats (n5-brief 1.0, 2.3).
- `mount_screen_open` (42): `containerId`, `inventoryColumns`, `entityId` (the horse's
  wire id): `writeContainerId(containerId)`, `writeVarInt(inventoryColumns)`,
  `writeInt(entityId)` (ClientboundMountScreenOpenPacket.txt 44–58; the container id is
  written as the other menus' are, n6-brief 3.20). Then the
  menu's `container_set_content` (18) as for any menu (n6-brief 3.15).
- Sounds: entity sounds are positional `sound` packets from `Entity.playSound` (volume,
  pitch as given; the seed as N6's sounds): wolf shake, growl, whine, pant; cat purr,
  purreow, beg, hiss, eat; parrot imitations and eat; horse step, gallop, breathe, jump,
  land, eat, angry, saddle, chest; wolf armour crack, damage, repair.
- Particles: wolf armour crack sends `level_particles` (`ServerLevel.sendParticles`, 20
  `item` armadillo scute). The others (`Level.addParticle`) are nothing on a server.

**Serverbound**:
- `interact` (26): `handleInteract` → `Entity.interact` → `Mob.interact` → `mobInteract`
  (n5-brief 2.7).
- `player_command` (42): `START_RIDING_JUMP` (3, with data 0..100) and `STOP_RIDING_JUMP`
  (4) to `player.getControlledVehicle()` if `PlayerRideableJumping`; `OPEN_INVENTORY` (5)
  to `player.getVehicle()` if `HasCustomInventoryScreen` (SGPLI 5213–5331). The edge now
  forwards only `OPEN_INVENTORY` and sprinting (services/edge/src/play.rs 199–214): the
  riding jump must reach the region of the rider.
- `move_vehicle` (34) and `player_input` (43): as for boats; a horse is a vehicle
  `handleMoveVehicle` checks only while saddled and steered by the player.
- `container_click` (18), `container_close` (19): the horse menu, as N6's menus.

### 9.6 Wild and water animals: packets and synched data

#### 9.6.1 Fox, panda, polar bear

Synched data beyond `AgeableMob`'s (0–17: Entity 0–7, LivingEntity 8–14, Mob 15
`DATA_MOB_FLAGS_ID`, AgeableMob 16 `DATA_BABY_ID`, 17 `AGE_LOCKED`). Serializer wire ids
from EntityDataSerializers.txt (n5 dump), registration order.

**Fox** (Fox.txt static block 2049–2066):

| Id | Field | Serializer (wire id) | Default | When it changes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 18 | variant | `INT` (1) | 0 red | spawn, breeding (from a parent), component, load |
| 19 | flags | `BYTE` (0) | 0 | 1 sitting, 4 crouching, 8 interested, 16 pouncing, 32 sleeping, 64 faceplanted, 128 defending; set by the goals and ticks of 6.1 |
| 20 | trusted 0 | `OPTIONAL_LIVING_ENTITY_REFERENCE` (13) | empty | breeding (love causes), spawn egg on a fox, load |
| 21 | trusted 1 | `OPTIONAL_LIVING_ENTITY_REFERENCE` (13) | empty | a second (and every later) trust |

The client draws the fox's sleeping, sitting, crouch, head tilt and pounce from the flags
alone (**Client**); `crouchAmount` and `interestedAngle` are computed on both sides from
them. `OPTIONAL_LIVING_ENTITY_REFERENCE` is `EntityReference.streamCodec()` made
optional (`ByteBufCodecs::optional`; EntityDataSerializers.txt 193–209), and the reference's
stream codec is `UUIDUtil.STREAM_CODEC` mapped (EntityReference.txt static block): a presence
boolean, then the UUID (its two longs, **Inferred**, `UUIDUtil` not dumped). The edge passes
it unchanged: it is not a wire id. The fox's pounce sets its pitch (`setXRot`), sent as rotation; its head yaw from
the look control as head rotation.

**Panda** (Panda.txt 1973–1998):

| Id | Field | Serializer | Default | When it changes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 18 | unhappy counter | `INT` | 0 | 32 when a breeding pair finds no bamboo, then −1 a tick |
| 19 | sneeze counter | `INT` | 0 | +1 a tick while sneezing (to 21), 0 when it stops |
| 20 | eat counter | `INT` | 0 | 1 when it starts eating, +1 a tick, 0 when it stops |
| 21 | main gene | `BYTE` | 0 | spawn, breeding, load |
| 22 | hidden gene | `BYTE` | 0 | spawn, breeding, load |
| 23 | flags | `BYTE` | 0 | 2 sneezing, 4 rolling, 8 sitting, 16 on back |

Three counters change every tick while they run, so a panda that eats sends its entity
data each tick (and its commit carries it, ADR-0028 section 3).

**Polar bear** (PolarBear.txt 498–503): 18 standing, `BOOLEAN` (8), false.

**Entity events** (`broadcastEntityEvent`, `ClientboundEntityEventPacket`):
- 45: the fox chews what it holds (Fox.txt 446–447; client: eight item particles,
  615–708). Sent while `ticksSinceEaten` is in 561–600 with a 1 in 10 chance a tick.
- 18: hearts, from `FoxBreedGoal.breed` on the first parent only (Fox$FoxBreedGoal.txt
  118–122); pandas and bears breed through `BreedGoal`/`Animal` (section on Animal).

**Level events**: 2001 (block break particles and sound, data the block state id) at a
faceplanted fox's position, with chance 0.2 a tick from the level random (Fox.txt
1421–1444).

**Sounds** (`playSound` on the entity: a seeded sound packet; the seed is the level's
draw, as in the earlier briefs): fox `FOX_AGGRO`, `FOX_EAT`, `FOX_SNIFF`, `FOX_SPIT`,
`FOX_BITE`, `FOX_SCREECH` (volume 2), `FOX_SLEEP`, `FOX_AMBIENT`, `FOX_HURT`, `FOX_DEATH`,
`SWEET_BERRY_BUSH_PICK_BERRIES`; panda `PANDA_CANT_BREED`, `PANDA_PRE_SNEEZE`,
`PANDA_SNEEZE`, `PANDA_EAT` (volume 0.5 or 1.0, pitch 0.8–1.2), `PANDA_BITE`, `PANDA_STEP`
(0.15), the three ambients, hurt, death; polar bear `POLAR_BEAR_WARNING` (at most every 40
ticks), ambient (baby or adult), hurt, death, step (0.15).

**Other packets**:
- `SetEquipment`: the fox's and panda's main hand (what a fox carries in its mouth, a
  panda's bamboo or cake) whenever it changes (pick-up, spit, eating finished, fed).
- `TakeItemEntity`: a fox's pick-up sends it with amount 0 (the stack was split down to
  nothing before `take`, Fox.txt 1380–1383); a panda's with the stack's count. Both
  remove the item entity (`discard`).
- New item entities: the fox's spit (pick-up delay 40, thrower the fox) and the rest of a
  picked stack, berries popped from a bush, the panda's dropped bamboo and sneeze gift,
  the fox's death drop, experience orbs at breeding.
- Block update: the berry bush's `AGE` set to 1 (flag 2), cave vines' `berries` false.
- Motion: the pounce (+0.9 up), a panda's roll (+0.27 up at steps 1, 7, 15, 23),
  `jumpFromGround` of pandas near a sneeze. Mobs' motion is tracked (deltas tracked for
  all three types).

#### 9.6.2 The bee

**Synched data** (Bee.txt static 1814–1821, `defineSynchedData` 166–183), after `Entity`
0–7, `LivingEntity` 8–14, `Mob` 15 (`DATA_MOB_FLAGS_ID`), `AgeableMob` 16 (`DATA_BABY_ID`,
`BOOLEAN`) and 17 (`AGE_LOCKED`, `BOOLEAN`); `Animal` adds none:

| Id | Accessor | Serializer, wire id | Default | Set by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 18 | `DATA_FLAGS_ID` | `BYTE`, 0 | 0 | bit 2 rolling (`aiStep`, each server tick), bit 4 has stung (`doHurtTarget`, load), bit 8 has nectar (pollination's `stop`, `dropOffNectar`, load) |
| 19 | `DATA_ANGER_END_TIME` | `LONG`, 2 (VarLong) | −1 | `setPersistentAngerEndTime`: game time + 400…780 on anger, −1 when calmed, the saved `anger_end_time` at load |

Wire ids verified against `n5-javap/.../EntityDataSerializers.txt` (registration order:
`BYTE` 0, `INT` 1, `LONG` 2 with `ByteBufCodecs.VAR_LONG`, `FLOAT` 3, … `BOOLEAN` 8).
Of the inherited data the bee changes: 5 `NO_GRAVITY` (true from its first move,
`FlyingMoveControl`; `NoGravity` is one of the keys a hive drops from a stored bee, and is
set again at release only if `Occupant.createEntity` does, **Inferred**, not dumped), 13
`DATA_STINGER_COUNT_ID` of what it stings (+1 per sting, the target's data), the health
(9) and effects (10, 11) of what it poisons. The client derives the anger it shows (the
red eyes, the aggressive loop) from 19 against **its own game time**, so the edge's time
packets must agree with the region's game time.

**Entity events**: none of the bee's own (the generic ones of `LivingEntity` and
`Animal`: hurt, death, love hearts on feeding; their sections).

**Level events**: 2011 (bee growth particles) at the grown block with data 15
(`BeeGrowCropGoal.tick`, BeeGrowCropGoal.txt 197–205), before the block is set.

**Sounds** (played at the bee by `Entity.playSound`, which on the server sends the sound
to the players near it, none excluded; the `Entity` section): `entity.bee.sting` (1, 1), `entity.bee.pollinate`
(1, 1), `entity.bee.hurt` and `entity.bee.death` (volume 0.4, pitch the living entity's
usual random pitch, another section). Hive sounds (BeehiveBlockEntity.txt
191–260, 274–475, 534–580; BeehiveBlock.txt 170–336; source `blocks`, volume and pitch 1):
`block.beehive.enter` at the block's low corner, `block.beehive.exit` at the block
position (the `BlockPos` form), `block.beehive.work` at the bottom centre with chance
0.005 a tick while occupied, `block.beehive.shear` at the harvesting player,
`item.bottle.fill` at the player and excluding them; `block.beehive.drip` is client-only.

**Game events**: the bee's own code posts none; the hive posts `block_change` with the bee
and the hive's state at entering and at each release, `shear` and `fluid_pickup` with the
player at harvesting (BeehiveBlockEntity.txt 248–255, 462–469; BeehiveBlock.txt 227–230,
283–286); `Entity`/`LivingEntity` post the
generic ones (hit, death, flap for a flying entity: section of `Entity`).

**Block entity**: a hive's occupants are not sent to clients (only to debug
subscribers, `DebugSubscriptions.BEES`/hive debug); the honey level is the block state.
The bee's debug value (`DebugBeeInfo`: hive, flower, travelling ticks, blacklist,
1572–1583, 1785–1800) is for debug renderers only.

- `ClientboundSound` / `ClientboundSoundEntity`: flops (`*.flop`), puffs
  (`puffer_fish.blow_up`, `.blow_out`, `.sting`), squirts, dolphin sounds, the bucket's
  `bucket.fill_fish` and `bucket.empty_fish`, `turtle.lay_egg` (a block sound, at the
  turtle's position, `BLOCKS`, 0.3, pitch 0.9–1.1). Entity sounds' pitch comes from the
  entity's random; the packets' seeds from the level's `soundSeedGenerator` (n6 brief
  9.x), which shifts no other draw.
- `ClientboundLevelParticles`: the squid's 30 ink particles (count 0, the velocity given,
  speed 0.10000000149011612). Clustine sends no particles yet.
- `ClientboundLevelEvent` 2001 (block destroy particles and sound, the state's id) at the
  laying turtle every 5 ticks of digging.
- `ClientboundSetEntityMotion` at once after a flop (`needsSync`), as the game's tracker
  sends it (N4 brief 9).
- `ClientboundTakeItemEntity` when a dolphin picks an item up (`take(item, count)`).
- `ClientboundGameEvent` 9 (`PUFFER_FISH_STING`, 0.0) to a player stung (never in
  creative).
- `ClientboundUpdateMobEffect` to a player given Dolphin's Grace (W7); poison to a stung
  survival player.
- `ClientboundBlockUpdate` for a turtle egg placed (`setBlockAndUpdate`, flags 3).
- `SetEquipment` for the dolphin's main hand when it picks up or drops an item (the
  living section's equipment changes).

The bat (6.11): `Bat.DATA_ID_FLAGS`, id **16**, `BYTE`, default 0, bit 1 resting; set on
waking and falling asleep. Level event **1025** (take-off) at its block when it wakes, unless
silent. Its position is snapped every resting tick (`setPosRaw`), which the tracker sends
as any move; its motion is not tracked (deltas off).

Turtle eggs (6.10.7): `ClientboundLevelEvent` **2012** (placed on sand, data 15), **2001**
(one per egg at a hatch, and at a trampled egg), sounds `turtle_egg.crack`, `.hatch`,
`.break` (`BLOCKS`, 0.7, pitch 0.9–1.1), block updates with flags 2.

### 9.7 Brains and the animals that have them: synched data and packets

#### 9.7.1 The brain and the shared behaviours (7.1 to 7.3)

- **Nothing of a brain is synched.** No memory, activity or behaviour state reaches the
  client; what it sees are the effects: positions and rotations (the look control turns
  the head: head rotation and body rotation as the controls' section sends them), poses
  through `Entity`'s `DATA_POSE` (id 6), the animals' own synched data (each animal's
  part below), sounds and entity events.
- **Poses set by behaviours**: `LongJumpMidJump` sets `Pose.LONG_JUMPING` at its start
  and `Pose.STANDING` at its stop (7.3.17). The goat's and the frog's renderers use it.
- **Entity events** (`ServerLevel.broadcastEntityEvent`, sent as `EntityEvent` to every
  client tracking the entity): **58** when a preparing goat stands on its ram start
  (every tick it stands there, 7.3.18), **59** when the preparation is abandoned (the
  target moved to another block), when it stops without a ram target, and at every
  `finishRam` (7.3.19). Both are the goat's head (lowered, raised): **Client**.
- **Sounds** (all `level.playSound(null, entity, sound, NEUTRAL, volume, pitch)`, so to
  every player near, the entity's position, no player left out):
  - the long jump's launch: the animal's `soundFn(mob)`, volume 1.0, pitch 1.0 (7.3.16);
  - the landing: the given landing sound, volume **2.0**, pitch 1.0, only if it landed on
    the ground (7.3.17);
  - the ram's preparation: `soundFn(goat)`, volume 1.0, pitch `getVoicePitch()` (two
    draws of the goat's random, 10.7);
  - the ram's impact on an entity or a horn-snapping block, and the horn's breaking when
    a horn drops: volume 1.0, pitch 1.0 (7.3.19).
- **Blocks changed by behaviours**: `InteractWithDoor` opens and closes doors through
  `DoorBlock.setOpen(entity, level, state, pos, open)`, which sends the block change and
  plays the door's sound and game event (phase B's door rules).
- **Hits**: `MeleeAttack` swings (`swingForAttack(MAIN_HAND)`: an `Animate` packet) and
  calls `doHurtTarget`; `RamTarget` calls `hurtServer` and `knockback`: the damage
  section's packets (`DamageEvent`, `SetEntityMotion` of the target).
- **Item entities**: `BehaviorUtils.throwItem` spawns an item (`AddEntity`, its motion)
  with the thrower set and the default pick-up delay (7.10).

#### 9.7.2 The axolotl, the frog and the tadpole (7.4, 7.5)

**Synched data.** Ids count on from the chain: `Entity` 0–7 (6 is `DATA_POSE`, `POSE`),
`LivingEntity` 8–14 (N5 brief 5.6), `Mob` 15 (`DATA_MOB_FLAGS_ID`, `BYTE`; the only
`defineId` in Mob.txt), `AgeableMob` 16 `DATA_BABY_ID` `BOOLEAN` false and 17
`AGE_LOCKED` `BOOLEAN` false (AgeableMob.txt 187–204, 648–658); `PathfinderMob`,
`Animal` and `WaterAnimal` define none. Serializer wire ids (EntityDataSerializers,
registration order, n5-javap): `BYTE` 0, `INT` 1, `BOOLEAN` 8, `OPTIONAL_UNSIGNED_INT`
19, `POSE` 20, `FROG_VARIANT` 27.

| Entity | Id | Accessor | Serializer | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Axolotl | 18 | `DATA_VARIANT` | `INT` (1) | 0 (lucy) | 0 lucy, 1 wild, 2 gold, 3 cyan, 4 blue |
| | 19 | `DATA_PLAYING_DEAD` | `BOOLEAN` (8) | false | `PLAY_DEAD_TICKS > 0`, set after the brain each tick unless NoAI |
| | 20 | `FROM_BUCKET` | `BOOLEAN` (8) | false | |
| Frog | 18 | `DATA_VARIANT_ID` | `FROG_VARIANT` (27) | `temperate` holder | written as the variant's registry id; Clustine's generated registry order is cold, temperate, warm (`clustine-data/src/generated/registries.rs:172`) |
| | 19 | `DATA_TONGUE_TARGET_ID` | `OPTIONAL_UNSIGNED_INT` (19) | empty | **the prey's entity id**: the edge must translate it to its wire id (n-plan 3.1) |
| Tadpole | 16 | `FROM_BUCKET` (`AbstractFish`) | `BOOLEAN` (8) | false | never set for a tadpole (its `setFromBucket` does nothing) |
| | 17 | `AGE_LOCKED` (`Tadpole`'s own) | `BOOLEAN` (8) | false | the tadpole is not an `AgeableMob`: no 16/17 of that class |

The frog sets `DATA_POSE`: `CROAKING` (Croak start), `USING_TONGUE` (ShootTongue),
`LONG_JUMPING` (the long jump, 7.3), `STANDING` (their stops). The client starts the
jump, croak and tongue animations from the pose (Frog.txt 303–351, **Client**). The
axolotl's and tadpole's animation states are the client's (`baseTick`'s
`isClientSide` branch; `Axolotl$AxolotlAnimationState`).

**Sounds** (all through `Entity.playSound` or `Level.playSound`, whose seeds are the
level's sound seed generator, N6 brief):

- Axolotl: `AXOLOTL_ATTACK` (1, 1) on attack; `AXOLOTL_HURT`, `AXOLOTL_DEATH`;
  ambient `AXOLOTL_IDLE_WATER` / `AXOLOTL_IDLE_AIR` (not while playing dead);
  `AXOLOTL_SPLASH`, `AXOLOTL_SWIM`; `BUCKET_FILL_AXOLOTL` (1, 1) at pick-up; the
  bucket's empty sound `BUCKET_EMPTY_AXOLOTL` (`MobBucketItem.playEmptySound`,
  `NEUTRAL`, 1, 1; Items.txt 3195–3280). The tadpole bucket's is
  `BUCKET_EMPTY_TADPOLE`. Hatching frogspawn plays `FROGSPAWN_HATCH` (`BLOCKS`, 1, 1).
- Frog: `FROG_TONGUE` and `FROG_EAT` (`NEUTRAL`, 2, 1, at the frog) from `ShootTongue`;
  `FROG_EAT` (2, 1) as `playEatingSound` when fed; `FROG_LAY_SPAWN` (`BLOCKS`, 1, 1);
  `FROG_LONG_JUMP` at the jump and `FROG_STEP` at landing (7.3); `FROG_STEP` (0.15, 1)
  as the step sound; `FROG_AMBIENT`, `FROG_HURT`, `FROG_DEATH`.
- Tadpole: `TADPOLE_FLOP` on land; `TADPOLE_HURT`, `TADPOLE_DEATH`; `TADPOLE_GROW_UP`
  (0.15, 1) when it becomes a frog (played by the tadpole); `BUCKET_FILL_TADPOLE`;
  `GOLDEN_DANDELION_USE` / `_UNUSE` (`PLAYERS`, 1, 1).

**Effects and events**: Regeneration (200 ticks) on the axolotl when `PlayDead` starts;
Regeneration (up to 2400) on, and Mining Fatigue removed from, the player
(`applySupportingEffects`) — `UpdateMobEffect` / `RemoveMobEffect` to that player, and
the effect particles' synched data (`LivingEntity` 10, 11). Game events
`BLOCK_PLACE` (frogspawn, with the frog) and `ENTITY_PLACE` (a mob bucket emptied). The
frogspawn is a block change (`setBlockAndUpdate`). Particles: the tadpole's age-lock
particles by `sendParticles` (`pause_mob_growth`, `reset_mob_growth`); the tadpole's
feeding particle is not sent (`Level.addParticle` is empty on a server). The prey of a
tongue is removed (`remove(KILLED)`): a `RemoveEntities` for it, after its death
(`LivingEntity.die`, another section) in the same tick.

#### 9.7.3 The goat, the camel and the armadillo (7.6 to 7.8)

Synched data ids are counted on top of the chain: `Entity` 0–7 (shared flags, air, custom
name, name visible, silent, no gravity, pose, ticks frozen), `LivingEntity` 8–14 (flags,
health, effect particles, effect ambience, arrows, stingers, sleeping pos), `Mob` 15 (mob
flags), `AgeableMob` 16 (`DATA_BABY_ID`, boolean) and **17 (`AGE_LOCKED`, boolean, new in
26.3)**; `Animal` adds none. Serialiser ids are the registration order of
`EntityDataSerializers` (n5 dump, static initialiser): `BYTE` 0, `INT` 1, `LONG` 2, `BOOLEAN`
8, `POSE` 20, `ARMADILLO_STATE` 36.

**Goat** (Goat.txt static 808–819, `defineSynchedData` 558–582):

| id | field | serialiser | default | set by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 18 | `DATA_IS_SCREAMING_GOAT` | `BOOLEAN` (8) | false | `finalizeSpawn`, breeding, load |
| 19 | `DATA_HAS_LEFT_HORN` | `BOOLEAN` | true | `finalizeSpawn` (10 % one horn), `dropHorn`, load |
| 20 | `DATA_HAS_RIGHT_HORN` | `BOOLEAN` | true | the same |

Entity events: 58 (start lowering the head) and 59 (stop), broadcast by
`PrepareRamNearestTarget` and `RamTarget` (7.3), read by `Goat.handleEntityEvent`
(508–528). The pose `LONG_JUMPING` (id 20 of `DATA_POSE`) during a long jump
(`LongJumpMidJump`, 7.3). Sounds (all `SoundSource` of the goat, `NEUTRAL`, unless said):
`GOAT_AMBIENT`/`GOAT_SCREAMING_AMBIENT`, `_HURT`, `_DEATH`, `GOAT_STEP` (0.15, 1), milk
(`player.playSound`, 1, 1: a level sound at the player in `SoundSource.PLAYERS`, sent to the players near but not to that player, whose client plays its own, Player.txt 685–707), eat (level sound, pitch from the level's
random), `GOAT_PREPARE_RAM`, `GOAT_RAM_IMPACT`, `GOAT_HORN_BREAK`, `GOAT_LONG_JUMP` and the
screaming forms. The horn is an `ItemEntity` spawned with velocity (N4's item spawn).

**Camel** (Camel.txt static, `defineSynchedData` 169–187), on top of `AbstractHorse`'s 18
(`DATA_ID_FLAGS`, `BYTE`: tame, saddled-was, bred, eating, standing, open mouth bits, the
horse section's):

| id | field | serialiser | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 19 | `DASH` | `BOOLEAN` (8) | false | dashing; the client starts its 55-tick cooldown when it turns true |
| 20 | `LAST_POSE_CHANGE_TICK` | `LONG` (2) | 0 | game time of the last pose change, negative while sitting |

The pose (`DATA_POSE`, id 6) is `SITTING` or `STANDING`. The camel husk adds nothing. Sounds:
`CAMEL_SIT`, `CAMEL_STAND` (`makeSound`), `CAMEL_DASH` (`makeSound`), `CAMEL_DASH_READY` (level
sound at the block position, `NEUTRAL`, 1, 1), `CAMEL_EAT` (pitch `1 + (f − f) × 0.2`),
`CAMEL_AMBIENT`, `CAMEL_HURT`, `CAMEL_DEATH`, `CAMEL_STEP`, `CAMEL_STEP_SAND`, `CAMEL_SADDLE`
(equip); the husk's `CAMEL_HUSK_*` forms (steps at 0.4). Game events `ENTITY_ACTION` (sit,
stand, dash), `EAT`. The horse inventory screen for a sneaking click: `ClientboundMountScreenOpenPacket(container
id, inventory columns, the camel's entity id)` then the `HorseInventoryMenu`'s contents
(n5 ServerPlayer.txt 3266–3307); the entity id is translated by the edge. Riding: `SetPassengers` with up to two (or
three by `canAddPassenger`'s `<= 2`) passengers; the rider's movement comes as the horse
family's vehicle input and jump commands (`PlayerCommand` start/stop riding jump), the horse
section's.

**Armadillo** (Armadillo.txt static 841–844, `defineSynchedData` 88–99):

| id | field | serialiser | default |
|---|---|---|---|
| 18 | `ARMADILLO_STATE` | `ARMADILLO_STATE` (36): the state's id 0–3 (a VarInt, `ByteBufCodecs.idMapper`, n6 ByteBufCodecs$31.txt 19–41) | `IDLE` (0) |

Entity event 64: peek (client plays `ARMADILLO_PEEK` locally and the peek animation),
broadcast by `ArmadilloBallUp`. Sounds: `ARMADILLO_ROLL`, `ARMADILLO_UNROLL_FINISH`
(`makeSound`), `ARMADILLO_LAND`, `ARMADILLO_UNROLL_START`, `ARMADILLO_BRUSH` (`playSound`),
`ARMADILLO_SCUTE_DROP` (pitch `(f − f) × 0.2 + 1`), `ARMADILLO_AMBIENT` (none when scared),
`ARMADILLO_HURT` / `ARMADILLO_HURT_REDUCED`, `ARMADILLO_DEATH`, `ARMADILLO_STEP` (0.15),
`ARMADILLO_EAT`. Game events `ENTITY_ACTION` (roll, unroll), `ENTITY_PLACE` (scute shed),
`ENTITY_INTERACT` (brushed). The scute is an item spawned by `spawnAtLocation`.

#### 9.7.4 The sniffer, the allay and the happy ghast (7.9 to 7.11)

Synched data ids are counted up the chain: `Entity` 0 to 7, `LivingEntity` 8 to 14
(flags, health, effect particles, effect ambience, arrows, stingers, sleeping position),
`Mob` 15 (mob flags), `AgeableMob` 16 (`DATA_BABY_ID`, boolean) and 17 (`AGE_LOCKED`,
boolean; AgeableMob.txt 648–658); `PathfinderMob` and `Animal` define none (no
accessors in their dumps).

**Sniffer** (`extends Animal`; Sniffer.txt 93–109, 1126–1133):

| Id | Field | Serialiser | Default | Set by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 18 | `DATA_STATE` | `SNIFFER_STATE` (`EntityDataSerializer.forValueType(Sniffer$State.STREAM_CODEC)`, EntityDataSerializers.txt 257–259: `ByteBufCodecs.idMapper(ByIdMap.continuous(id, values, ZERO), id)`, Sniffer$State.txt 146–152, a VarInt of the state's id, which equals its ordinal: ByteBufCodecs$31, n6-javap) | `IDLING` (0) | `transitionTo` |
| 19 | `DATA_DROP_SEED_AT_TICK` | `INT` | 0 | `onDiggingStart` (`tickCount + 120`) |

Packets and events: entity event **63** when digging starts (`broadcastEntityEvent`,
Sniffer.txt 451–455; no handler in the server's classes, the client's `Sniffer` is not
read: send it). Sounds (all at the sniffer, its sound source): `entity.sniffer.happy`,
`scenting` (pitch 1.3 for a baby), `sniffing`, `digging_stop`, `drop_seed`, `egg_plop`
(pitch drawn), `eat` (neutral, pitch drawn from the level's random), `idle` (ambient, not
while digging or searching), `hurt`, `death`, `step` (0.15). Client-only:
`entity.sniffer.searching` every 20 ticks while `SEARCHING`, digging particles and hit
sounds. Game event `entity_action` at the head block every 10 ticks while `DIGGING`.
Item entities: the seed (at the head block's corner) and the egg (at the sniffer's feet).
The digging state changes the bounding box (`refreshDimensions`), which the client also
computes from the state.

**Allay** (`extends PathfinderMob`; Allay.txt 167–184, 1187–1194):

| Id | Field | Serialiser | Default | Set by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 16 | `DATA_DANCING` | `BOOLEAN` | false | `setDancing` |
| 17 | `DATA_CAN_DUPLICATE` | `BOOLEAN` | true | `setDuplicationCooldown` (`cooldown == 0`) |

Packets and events: entity event **18** on duplication (three hearts, **Client**);
equipment (main hand) when the kind of held item changes (`equipmentHasChanged`); the
pick-up animation (`take`, `TakeItemEntity`) for each item picked up; arm swing when a
player takes its item (`swing(MAIN_HAND, animation)`). Sounds: `block.amethyst_block.
chime` (2, 1), `entity.allay.item_given` (2, 1), `entity.allay.item_taken` (2, 1), all
three leaving out the interacting player; `entity.allay.throw` (1, one of sixteen
pitches, on some throws); ambient `ambient_with_item` or `ambient_without_item`, `hurt`,
`death`, volume 0.4. Thrown items are item entities with the allay as thrower.

**Happy ghast** (`extends Animal`; HappyGhast.txt 968–985, 1302–1309):

| Id | Field | Serialiser | Default | Set by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 18 | `IS_LEASH_HOLDER` | `BOOLEAN` | false | `tick` (`leashHolderTime > 0`) |
| 19 | `STAYS_STILL` | `BOOLEAN` | false | `syncStayStillFlag` (`serverStillTimeout > 0`) |

Packets: `ClientboundEntityPositionSyncPacket` to trackers when it begins to stay still
(after `syncPacketPositionCodec`, HappyGhast.txt 81–95); exact positions while still
(`setRequiresPrecisePosition`, the edge's choice of absolute moves); passengers
(`SetPassengers`, up to four); the body slot's equipment (harness); vehicle moves from
the controlling player's client (`MoveVehicle`). Sounds: `entity.happy_ghast.harness_
goggles_down` (first rider), `harness_goggles_up` (last off), ambient, hurt and death
(`ghastling` or `happy_ghast`, volume 1 or 4), source neutral.

**Copper golem** (7.13). On top of `Mob`'s ids (0–15; `PathfinderMob` and

| Id | Field | Serialiser | Default | Set by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 16 | `DATA_WEATHER_STATE` | `WEATHERING_COPPER_STATE` | `UNAFFECTED` | `updateWeathering` (next stage); axe scrape and lightning one stage back, with force (`set(…, true)`, sent even if equal); `spawn(state)`; load |
| 17 | `COPPER_GOLEM_STATE` | `COPPER_GOLEM_STATE` (`idle` 0, `getting_item` 1, `getting_no_item` 2, `dropping_item` 3, `dropping_no_item` 4) | `IDLE` | the interaction hook at tick 1; `onTravelling` and `actuallyHurt` → `IDLE` |

### 9.8 Mobs made with the chunk and the structures' entities: packets and synched data

Nothing of section 8 is a packet of its own: a mob made with a chunk, or placed by a
structure, reaches a client as any entity does when its chunk is sent and its tracker
pairs (`ServerEntity`, the N4 brief, and the animals' section of this brief for the farm
animals' data). What section 8 adds to the edge is the data of the structures' mobs and
of the golems, and two golems' entity events.

**Synched data of the mobs that structures place** (the accessor ids continue after
`Entity`'s 0–7, `LivingEntity`'s 8–14 (the n5 brief, 5.6) and `Mob`'s 15
(`DATA_MOB_FLAGS_ID`, a byte); each class's own ids follow its superclasses', in the order
of its static block; `PatrollingMonster`, `Monster`, `PathfinderMob`, `AbstractGolem`,
`AbstractIllager` and `Animal` define none (no accessor in any of their dumps).
Defaults are those of
`defineSynchedData`):

| Type | Id | Accessor (class) | Serialiser | Default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| villager | 16 | `DATA_BABY_ID` (`AgeableMob`, 194) | `BOOLEAN` | false (the baby template's age makes it true when read) |
| | 17 | `AGE_LOCKED` (`AgeableMob`, 200) | `BOOLEAN` | false |
| | 18 | `DATA_UNHAPPY_COUNTER` (`AbstractVillager`, 84) | `INT` | 0 |
| | 19 | `DATA_VILLAGER_DATA` (`Villager`) | `VILLAGER_DATA` | `createDefaultVillagerData()`; the template's when read |
| | 20 | `DATA_VILLAGER_DATA_FINALIZED` (`Villager`, 762) | `BOOLEAN` | false; true once the template's `VillagerData` is read |
| zombie villager | 16 | `DATA_BABY_ID` (`Zombie`, 258) | `BOOLEAN` | false |
| | 17 | `DATA_SPECIAL_TYPE_ID` (`Zombie`, 264) | `INT` | 0 |
| | 18 | `DATA_DROWNED_CONVERSION_ID` (`Zombie`, 270) | `BOOLEAN` | false |
| | 19 | `DATA_CONVERTING_ID` (`ZombieVillager`, 51) | `BOOLEAN` | false |

| | 17 | `DATA_USING_ITEM` (`Witch`, 129) | `BOOLEAN` | false |

| elder guardian | 16 | `DATA_ID_MOVING` (`Guardian`, 180) | `BOOLEAN` | false |
| | 17 | `DATA_ID_ATTACK_TARGET` (`Guardian`, 186) | `INT` | 0 (an entity id: one the edge translates, the n-plan's 3.1) |
| allay | 16 | `DATA_DANCING` (`Allay`, 174) | `BOOLEAN` | false |
| | 17 | `DATA_CAN_DUPLICATE` (`Allay`, 180) | `BOOLEAN` | true |
| cat | 16, 17 | `DATA_BABY_ID`, `AGE_LOCKED` (`AgeableMob`) | `BOOLEAN` | false |
| | 18 | `DATA_FLAGS_ID` (`TamableAnimal`, 37) | `BYTE` | 0 |
